network.trusted_hosts_hint:
Trusted hosts: optional, comma-separated host or host:port.
Empty = auto-trust all LAN IPs when bound to LAN; filled = only trust specified addresses,
no longer auto-trust the entire LAN.
network.auth_label: Enable Web auth (requires token exchange for Cookie on first visit)
network.auth_warning_lan_off: [Security Warning] Web token auth is OFF + bound to LAN 0.0.0.0: Anyone on the LAN can access the interface directly (only Host/Origin fence protection). If you don't need LAN access, switch back to Local 127.0.0.1 to eliminate external exposure.
network.auth_warning_local_off: [Tip] Web token auth is OFF but bound to Local 127.0.0.1, external networks cannot reach it, actual risk is very low. Be careful if you switch to LAN binding.

log.launch_hint: DeepSeek Harness Green Edition launcher started. Click [Install Env] or [Start Service] to begin.

about.subtitle: Green Edition · All files and dependencies fully localized
about.author: Author
about.local_point_1: · Double-click to use, no installation, no manual config needed
about.local_point_2: · All runtime dependencies in program root runtime/: Portable Node.js / Bundled Python /
about.local_point_3: dsh core / npm-pnpm cache / session data / temp files
about.local_point_4: · Does not write to user home, no system environment variable changes, no C: drive usage
about.local_point_5: · Entire folder copy-and-run (copy to any location or computer)
about.local_point_6: · Updates only touch the launcher itself, never overwrite config.json (your settings) or data

cleanup.update_confirm_detail:
Will clear update cache directory (runtime/update),
including: cached new version zip, extracted content, old file backup before overwrite, update job files.

If the updater is still running, occupied files will be skipped without affecting updates. Continue?
cleanup.backup_confirm_detail:
Will clear backup directory (runtime/backup),
including: old version dirs auto-backed up before dsh updates, and old scattered dsh-backup-* residues.

After cleanup you cannot rollback to old versions! Continue?

install.python_fail_detail:
Node and dsh installed successfully, but bundled portable Python failed to download.

This does not affect the dsh service (service runs on Node), but the status indicator at top will show red.
You can click Install Env again later to retry; or manually extract python-build-standalone's
install_only archive into runtime/python.
install.using_portable_npm: Using npm bundled with portable Node for installation
install.using_system_npm: Using system npm for installation (make sure Node.js is installed)
install.please_wait: Installing dsh (first install may take a few minutes, please be patient; npm output shows in real time, watch for progress) ...
install.install_fail: dsh install failed, check network and retry (see npm output above)
install.env_done_python_fail: Environment installation complete, but bundled Python download failed

single_instance.already_running:

end DSH_Launcher.exe in Task Manager then reopen.
